channel.title: Houston Public Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Houston Public Media (houstonpublicmedia.org)

item.title: Jasmine Crockett leads James Talarico by double digits in Senate Democratic primary, poll finds
item.description: On the Republican side, Ken Paxton and John Cornyn were neck-and-neck and in position for a runoff, according to the poll from the University of Texas’ Texas Politics Project.

item.title: NASA begins rolling Artemis II away from launch pad for repairs as moon mission is pushed back
item.description: Engineers over the weekend found helium flow was disrupted in one of the rockets. Now, Artemis II is making the 4-mile, 12-hour journey back to the Kennedy Space Center’s Vehicle Assembly Building.

item.title: Apple to expand Houston facility, bringing Mac mini production to U.S. for the first time
item.description: Apple says thousands of jobs will be created by expanding its Houston campus, which was completed ahead of schedule and began operations last October.

item.title: What propositions are on the Texas March primary ballots
item.description: Primary ballot propositions may not carry the force of law, but they can shape the legislative agendas the parties pursue next year. In the case of the GOP, that makes them particularly worth studying.

item.title: Hello Houston (February 25, 2026)
item.description: Today: We discuss the EPA’s decision to rescind the 2009 Endangerment Finding, talk with the actor playing Jerry Lee Lewis in the musical “Million Dollar Quartet,” and learn about the upcoming ReelMusic concert event.

item.title: Hello Houston – The Commuter Cut (February 25, 2026)
item.description: For our busy Houston commuters, we have – The Commuter Cut – a special 40-minute version of our show to listen to during your journey home.

item.title: Short stories link together experiences from the Pakistani diaspora
item.description: Houston writer Tayyba Kanwal talks with Houston Matters about her new collection of short stories, "Talking with Boys."

item.title: The 2026 Houston rodeo kicks off Monday. Here’s what you need to know
item.description: There are several related events scheduled ahead of the rodeo, which starts March 2 at NRG Park. Tickets remain available to all rodeo performances and concerts.

item.title: Harris County settles $1.25 million federal lawsuit from special needs teen’s beating death inside jail
item.description: The civil rights lawsuit emerged in 2022, nearly a year after 19-year-old 98-pound Fred Harris was attacked and beaten to death inside a jail cell by an inmate nearly twice his size.

item.title: Appeals court strikes down AG’s effort to halt Harris County’s immigrant legal services fund
item.description: While the letter appears to be a legal win for Harris County, justices concluded that the opinion won't prevent the state from arguing that the county's Immigrant Legal Services Fund is a violation of the state's constitution.
